author: Davidayo
html: Enjoyed this review of “Get Your Hands Dirty on Clean Architecture – Second Edition”! It sounds like a really practical guide to tackling the challenge of creating maintainable and well-organized code. The breakdown of different approaches and considerations is super helpful, especially the part about consciously taking shortcuts – something we all do, but need to be aware of the potential consequences. It’s great to know there’s a resource out there that complements the more theoretical texts. Speaking of code quality, if you’re finding yourself in a messy code situation, this article might give you some insights: https://www.davidayo.com/blog/is-your-code-messy-here-are-the-downfalls/“
